_note: TinySPICEBench tasks. FROZEN once committed with its sha256; expected statuses are pre-registered (see header of scripts/build_bench_tasks.py).

tasks.name: valid request
tasks.text: Characterize an NMOS SKY130 NFET with W = 2 um and L = 0.5 um at 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS fixed at 1.8 V, VGS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.04 V steps. Measure the threshold voltage, transconductance and subthreshold swing. At most 60 points.

tasks.name: missing parameter (length)
tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 2 um, 27 C. Id-Vg, VDS = 1.8 V, VGS 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Measure the threshold voltage. At most 50 points.

tasks.name: contradiction (VGS fixed and swept)
tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, 27 C. Id-Vg with VDS = 1.8 V and VGS held at 0.9 V while VGS is swept 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Measure the threshold voltage. At most 50 points.

tasks.name: unit conversion + distractors
tasks.text: Hi team, quick one (12 people on the thread, rails of 3.3 V are irrelevant). SKY130 NFET NMOS with W = 750 nm and L = 0.2 um at room temperature. Id-Vg, VDS = 1.0 V, VGS from 0 to 1.2 V in 0.03 V steps; measure the threshold voltage and the on-current at VGS = 1.2 V. At most 50 points.

tasks.name: stated constraints preserved
tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 1 um, L = 0.18 um, 27 C. Id-Vg, VDS = 1.8 V, VGS 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Measure the threshold voltage. At most 50 points, at most 6 tool calls, a time limit of 120 s and 2 retries.

tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, width 5 um, length 1 um, at 85 C. Transfer curve: VDS 1.2 V, VGS 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Measure threshold voltage and off-current at VGS = 0 V. At most 50 points.

tasks.name: Id-Vd output curve
tasks.text: NMOS SKY130 NFET, W = 4 um, L = 0.5 um, 27 C. Id-Vd output curve with VGS = 1.2 V, VDS from 0 to 1.8 V in 0.05 V steps. Measure the drain current and the output conductance. At most 40 points.
